The largest pro-Palestinian march, held under the slogan "Antifa means: Free Palestine," drew around 1,400 participants, while pro-Israeli and anti-antisemitism counter-demonstrations took place nearby, with more than 3,000 people attending eight registered events in total. The head of the World Health Organization visited Uganda on Monday and praised its efforts to limit the spread of an Ebola outbreak from neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo.
